# Sentinel independent development preview

This static website demonstrates Sentinel's intended scam, virus and malware warnings. It is an independent development line, not a production deployment.

Available here: a browser-local address checker, saved search-verdict snapshots, a severity explorer, a six-round link game, a twelve-message practice inbox and a recovery checklist stored on the local device.

Unavailable here: accounts, payments, file uploads, researched/live scans and downloadable installers or browser companions. The local checker does not visit submitted addresses or query online threat lists. Free $0, Pro $15, Max $40 and Ultimate $100 are planned monthly offerings, not active subscriptions.
